desc.zh: 从全 1 位值推导按长度枚举与精确整数二分。
desc.en: Derive a descending-length search and exact integer binary search from all-ones place values.

complexity: O((log n)^2) integer operations; O(1) integer cells (O(log n) bits) extra space

concepts.name: Monotone exact search
concepts.description: Discard impossible integer bases using an inclusive interval invariant.
